Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 646 PM EDT Mon Oct 12 2026

- Scatted showers with a few isolated thunderstorms overnight.

- Unseasonably warm Tuesday with highs above 80F.

- Showers possible Tuesday night into Wednesday.

- Turning more seasonable Thursday and Friday, then becoming 
chillier over the weekend.

&&

.AVIATION...

Approaching mid level moisture influx within weak elevated 
instability is driving ongoing convective development across western 
Lower Mi. The gradual advection of this mid level moisture and 
presence of elevated instability will sustain a chance of showers 
and isolated thunderstorms through the night. A cold front 
approaching MBS during the night and better elevated forcing will 
support higher shower chances at MBS. The pace of upstream 
development suggest convective chances may arrive mid to late 
evening at MBS. Trailing mid level moisture/instability axis farther 
south supports higher showers/thunderstorm chances remaining later 
into the overnight at the metro Detroit terminals. Drier air will 
advect across the area within a tightening west-southwest gradient 
on Tuesday. Despite relatively shallow mixing depths, model 
soundings and probability guidance supports frequent gusts in the 25 
to 30 knot range Tues afternoon.

D21/DTW Convection... The better mid level moisture axis will 
traverse metro Detroit overnight into the pre dawn hours on Tuesday. 
A chance of showers will be maintained in the forecast in the 07Z to 
11Z time frame. While isolated thunderstorms are possible across the 
airspace, the chances for thunderstorems at metro airport is under 
30 percent.

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* Low for thunderstorms overnight into early Tuesday morning.
